# goldband

> goldband is Goldband Loop: AI coding skills, a design CLI, and a Markdown-to-PDF CLI. This file indexes every capability so agents can discover and invoke them without crawling individual SKILL.md files.

Conventions:
- Capabilities use `$goldband <capability> <action>`; historical workflow names are not aliases.
- Design commands run as `design <command> [args]` (or `$D`).
- Project-specific config lives in `CLAUDE.md`. Always read it first.

## Capability actions

- `$goldband benchmark workflow`: Benchmark product or workflow performance.
- `$goldband context restore`: Restore saved working context.
- `$goldband context retro`: Summarize recent work and lessons.
- `$goldband context save`: Save current working context.
- `$goldband design consult`: Define a design direction and system.
- `$goldband document generate`: Audit documentation coverage and prepare documentation artifacts.
- `$goldband investigate code`: Investigate code or runtime behavior.
- `$goldband ios qa`: Run iOS QA.
- `$goldband knowledge recall`: Inspect Goldband learnings and knowledge.
- `$goldband plan create`: Create a versioned Work Map for tracked work.
- `$goldband plan sync`: Preview, inspect, or synchronize a Work Map tracker projection.
- `$goldband qa app`: Run product QA and record evidence.
- `$goldband review code`: Independent read-only semantic code review.
- `$goldband review security`: Review security and trust boundaries.
- `$goldband safety freeze`: Enable read-only freeze-mode for a Claude session.
- `$goldband safety guard`: Enable careful-mode for a Claude session.
- `$goldband safety unfreeze`: Disable freeze-mode for a Claude session.
- `$goldband system health`: Inspect Goldband health and installation state.
- `$goldband system upgrade`: Upgrade Goldband.
